s: Today we learn five easy school words.
They are art, biology, board, board pen, and board rubber.
These words are about school and learning.
Art is pictures, drawings, and sculptures.
I like to draw and make art.
In art class, we make art with colors.
My sister makes art at home.
Art is fun, and art is beautiful.
Children make art at school every week.
Tell a friend, I like art.

Biology is the study of living things, like plants and animals.
We learn about plants in biology class.
In biology, we look at small plants.
In biology, we learn about animals too.
My biology teacher is very kind.
I like biology because I love animals.
A board is a flat piece of wood or plastic.
We write on the board in class.
Yes, the teacher writes on the board every day.
The board in our class is big and white.
I can see the board from my desk.
In old schools, the board was black.

A board pen is a pen for writing on a whiteboard.
Please use a board pen for the whiteboard.
The teacher holds a board pen.
I have a board pen in my bag.
A board pen writes well on the board.
Please give me the board pen.
A board rubber is a small thing to clean a whiteboard.
Can you pass me the board rubber?
I use the board rubber after class.
The board rubber makes the board clean.
The teacher puts the board rubber on the desk.
I need the board rubber now.
With the board rubber, the board is white again.
Thank you for the board rubber.
Let us remember our five words.
Biology is the study of plants and animals.
A board is flat, a board pen writes on the board, and a board rubber cleans the board.
